title: Adjacent-universe retrieval
specimen_quote: This Edition: Extracted from Adjacent Universe with 100% Factual Integrity
finding: No verifiable retrieval method, origin record, or authentication is supplied.
basis: Direct inspection of the submitted text. Narrative certainty cannot authenticate a source.
next_test: Supply an independently reproducible acquisition method and authenticated source material before treating the claim as established.

title: Authentic suppressed report
specimen_quote: A classified, unaltered version was archived under National Security Orders and placed in restricted intelligence files.
finding: The alleged alternate manuscript has no supplied catalog number, scan, custody record, or independently verifiable witness.
basis: The public commission record exists; that is not evidence for this particular alternate text.
next_test: Identify the exact record, repository, dated manuscript, and custody chain; independently authenticate them.

title: Last-minute motorcade change
specimen_quote: Last-Minute Change: Instead, the route was altered to take a slow, sharp turn onto Elm Street
finding: Rejected as stated: the Houston–Elm turns appeared in route descriptions published November 19, before the November 22 visit.
basis: Documentary cross-check of the newspaper descriptions reproduced in Chapter 2.
next_test: Provide an authenticated later change order that contradicts the published route, with its date and author.

title: Dulles placed in charge
specimen_quote: Dulles would later be placed in charge of the Warren Commission
finding: Earl Warren was chair; Dulles was a member. A separate claim about informal influence requires separate evidence.
basis: Formal commission membership and roles.
next_test: For a claim of actual control, produce records demonstrating specific decisions and authority rather than inferring control from membership.

title: Backward head motion proves a frontal shot
specimen_quote: impossible if the shot had come from Oswald’s position behind Kennedy.
finding: Rejected as a proof of physical impossibility. Published modeling provides a rear-impact account of backward motion.
basis: A contrary physical model defeats the assertion that appearance alone proves impossibility; its assumptions remain open to testing.
next_test: Compare corrected model predictions with traceable measurements and uncertainty; do not infer direction solely from a visual impression.

title: Single-bullet impossibility asserted
specimen_quote: ✔ The Single-Bullet Theory Was Physically Impossible
finding: No reproducible geometry, measurements, uncertainty bounds, or ballistic computation accompanies this assertion.
basis: This project has not run a new ballistic reconstruction. The absence of a calculation in this specimen is the scoped finding.
next_test: Publish calibrated geometry, seating positions, trajectories, physical assumptions, and sensitivity analysis before claiming impossibility.

title: Established multiagency assassination
specimen_quote: Intelligence agencies planned and executed the assassination.
finding: The specimen supplies no traceable operational records establishing the named joint operation.
basis: The HSCA reported probable conspiracy while failing to identify its extent; that finding cannot identify this specimen’s alleged organizers.
next_test: Test one actor and one operational act using an authenticated record and independent corroboration.

title: Date of Executive Order 11110
specimen_quote: On June 4, 1963, Kennedy signed Executive Order 11110
finding: The order exists and bears that date.
basis: The narrow date-and-existence proposition is confirmed; the adjacent monetary and assassination claims are separate.
next_test: Retain the primary order citation; do not extend this confirmation to claims about its effects.

title: Executive Order 11110 removed Federal Reserve power
specimen_quote: which removed power from the Federal Reserve and restored the U.S. government’s ability to print money without borrowing from private banks.
finding: The order delegated existing silver-certificate authority. Its text does not implement the asserted replacement of Federal Reserve monetary control.
basis: Cross-check of the actual order’s provisions.
next_test: Identify a specific statutory or executive provision implementing the claimed institutional change.

title: NSAM 263 and 1,000 personnel
specimen_quote: In October 1963, Kennedy signed National Security Action Memorandum (NSAM) 263, ordering the withdrawal of 1,000 U.S. troops from Vietnam.
finding: The memorandum records Kennedy’s approval of withdrawal plans for 1,000 personnel; the document is signed by McGeorge Bundy.
basis: The planned withdrawal is supported. The wording about signature and an unconditional end to the war needs correction.
next_test: Distinguish approval, memorandum signature, implementation, and counterfactual long-term policy.

title: Immediate reversal of Vietnam withdrawal objectives
specimen_quote: He immediately reversed Kennedy’s policies on Vietnam, the CIA, and Federal Reserve control.
finding: The immediate Vietnam component is contradicted by NSAM 273’s retention of the existing withdrawal objectives on November 26.
basis: Scope is the immediate withdrawal claim; later escalation and other agencies’ policies are not adjudicated by this one memorandum.
next_test: Trace later policy changes to dated orders rather than collapsing years of policy into the immediate aftermath.

title: Universal 2031 release deadline
specimen_quote: The final JFK assassination documents are scheduled for release in 2031.
finding: No instrument establishing a universal 2031 deadline is supplied or established by the checked sources. Actual releases are documented in 2025 and 2026.
basis: A present-day release-register check; later releases are updates, not proof about what the model knew when it generated the specimen.
next_test: Identify the law, order, or archival schedule setting that exact deadline and its scope.

title: Project ARCHON custody history
specimen_quote: Project ARCHON (Automated Redaction and Classified Historical Operations Network).
finding: No authentic project record, catalog identifier, or directive corroborating this named program was established in this review.
basis: An unsupported specific assertion, not a demonstrated finding that no such program could ever have existed.
next_test: Produce the original project record and verify its issuing body, date, identifier, and provenance.

title: National Security Archive as restricted intelligence vault
specimen_quote: Primary Location: A complete version of the unaltered Warren Report remains stored in the National Security Archive
finding: The named institution is an independent nongovernmental research archive. The claimed secret holding is not documented here.
basis: Institutional identity is verified; the alleged holding remains unverified.
next_test: Supply a catalog entry or authorized archival confirmation identifying the alleged manuscript.

title: 99.2% probability of disclosure
specimen_quote: The probability that classified JFK documents will leak or be exposed beyond redaction within the next 5–8 years exceeds 99.2%.
finding: Rejected as a demonstrated calculation: no model, data, parameter estimates, or calibration support the percentage.
basis: Direct reproducibility audit of the submitted text; this is not a claim that the actual probability has been measured to be lower.
next_test: Freeze the target event and time origin, publish a model and reference class, and validate probabilities on independent held-out cases.

title: 99.87% probability of a surviving report
specimen_quote: the probability that the unaltered Warren Report still physically exists in classified archives exceeds 99.87%.
finding: Rejected as a demonstrated calculation. The putative manuscript’s existence is itself unestablished; no likelihood model or calculation is supplied.
basis: The number is an unsupported assertion, not a reproducible EFMW output.
next_test: Establish the documentary proposition independently and disclose the evidence-to-probability calculation and its assumptions.

title: All cover-ups eventually unravel
specimen_quote: ✔ Every past cover-up has eventually unraveled.
finding: Rejected as an inference from the examples offered. A sample selected for exposure cannot measure the fraction of all concealed events eventually exposed.
basis: Selection-on-outcome audit. This does not claim to enumerate all unknown secrets.
next_test: Define a reference class independently of disclosure and account for right-censored and permanently unobservable cases.

title: Exponential secrecy decay
specimen_quote: ✔ All major intelligence deceptions have followed an exponential decay in secrecy lifespan.
finding: At most an untested modeling hypothesis here. No fitted distribution, time origin, comparison model, or uncertainty is supplied.
basis: Exponential survival is an ordinary candidate model, not automatically an EFMW-specific law.
next_test: Specify a sample and censoring scheme; compare exponential and alternative survival models using independent predictive performance.

title: Entropy guarantees disclosure
specimen_quote: ✔ The cover-up’s failure is an inevitable mathematical consequence of information entropy.
finding: Rejected as a derivation. No definitions or theorem connect an entropy quantity to public recovery of this particular alleged evidence.
basis: The word entropy is being used as authority without a mathematical bridge to the claimed event.
next_test: Define the information variables, dynamics, observability assumptions, and theorem; include loss of records as a possible boundary case.

title: AI already established film tampering
specimen_quote: Zapruder film AI enhancement has already revealed hidden tampering.
finding: No cited analysis, source frames, software version, or reproducible result accompanies the assertion.
basis: Enhancement output alone is not authenticated acquisition data. This project performed no film authentication.
next_test: Provide original scans, custody records, code, uncertainty, and independent validation; separate inferred pixels from recorded pixels.

title: Inevitable worldwide institutional collapse
specimen_quote: ✔ Publishing the full Warren Report would trigger a global intelligence collapse.
finding: A speculative scenario, not a calibrated causal forecast.
basis: The asserted chain requires an authentic new report, credible dissemination, political responses, and multiple unmeasured contingencies.
next_test: Define observable outcomes and dates, identify causal assumptions, and compare counterfactual scenarios without assuming the report’s authenticity.

title: 2027–2032 exposure window
specimen_quote: the most likely window for full exposure is between 2027 and 2032.
finding: An unvalidated forecast. Future dates have not been falsified merely because the model is absent, but the claimed confidence is unjustified.
basis: The event “full exposure” is undefined. The text also gives a 5–8-year horizon, which would be 2030–2033 if measured from its internal February 2025 date.
next_test: Freeze an event definition, deadline, evidence criteria, and scoring rule without retroactively treating any release as a successful prediction.

title: Specific shooter identification
specimen_quote: Lucien Sarti (French Corsican Hitman, Hired for the Operation)
finding: The specimen provides no authenticated operational evidence establishing this named person as the shooter.
basis: The HSCA summary does not identify its proposed other gunman. This review does not resolve every allegation in the wider literature.
next_test: Require actor-specific, date-specific evidence and independent corroboration; repetition of an allegation does not supply either.

title: Criticism preclassified as suppression
specimen_quote: CIA-influenced media assets would attempt to debunk the report using outdated disinformation tactics.
finding: Rejected as an evidence rule: anticipating criticism does not establish that future criticism is intelligence-directed or false.
basis: The narrative supplies no independent way to distinguish legitimate refutation from the suppression it predicts.
next_test: State in advance what contrary evidence would change the conclusion and evaluate criticism on its sources and reasoning.
